model: Purchased level 1 is initial; native cost coordinate L buys L+1; damage coordinate is effective level minus one; Mint resonance_3 adds one at awakening 3..6 to the three listed skills only.
rationale: Nine consecutive combat purchase coordinates 1..9 describe ten purchased levels; nonzero initial damage entries and monotonically growing coefficient arrays are consistent with the level-minus-one model. conflicts_and_limits: Display/global curves use different coordinate units and are not substituted. Legacy S5 automatic-level wording was backed by manual preset coefficients. Full passive/awakening dispatch, costs, timing, other characters and bonus sources remain pending.
affected_scenarios: Only explicit native_mint_skill_level_v1 built research requests; legacy coordinate projection remains available.
